title: Archaeasins: deep learning finds antibiotic candidates in the archaeal proteome
summary: The APEX 1.1 deep learning platform scanned 233 archaeal proteomes and flagged 12,623 candidate antimicrobial molecules. Of 80 synthesized candidates, 93% showed in vitro activity against key pathogens, and three selected compounds reduced a drug-resistant bacterium in animal models after a single dose. Candidate and synthesis counts differ between press coverage and secondary reports, and the mouse details come from press coverage rather than the full text, so the paper's own figures should be checked.
ai_technology: APEX 1.1 deep learning antimicrobial peptide predictor
